[[Istanbul]], Turkey | capacity = 4,274 | coordinates = {{Coord|41.024444|28.697778|format=dms|type:landmark_scale:3000_region:TR|display=it}} | chairman = Ecmel Faik Sarıalioğlu | mgrtitle = Head coach | manager = Barış Kanbak | league = {{Turkish football updater|İstanbulspor}} | season = {{Turkish football updater|İstanbulspor2}} | position = {{Turkish football updater|İstanbulspor3}} | website = {{URL|http://www.istanbulspor.com.tr/}} | current = 2024–25 İstanbulspor season |pattern_la1 = _istanbulspor2223h |pattern_b1 = _istanbulspor2223 0002 istanbulspor-h |pattern_ra1 = _istanbulspor2223h |shorts1 = 000000 |socks1 = 000000 |pattern_la2 = _istanbulspor2223a |pattern_b2 = _istanbulspor2223 0001 istanbulspor-a1 |pattern_ra2 = _istanbulspor2223a |shorts2 = 000000 |socks2 = 000000 |pattern_la3 = _istanbulspor2223t |pattern_b3 = _istanbulspor2223 0000 istanbulspor-t |pattern_ra3 = _istanbulspor2223t |shorts3 = FFFFFF |socks3 = FFFFFF }} '''İstanbulspor Kulübü''' is a Turkish [[association football|football]] and [[sports club]] founded by [[Istanbul High School]] students in 1926. In 2004–05, they were relegated from the Turkish [[Süper Lig]] (Super League) to the [[TFF First League]]. For many decades, it was the fourth most famous and well-developed professional football club in [[Istanbul]], coming after [[Beşiktaş J.K.|Beşiktaş]], [[Galatasaray S.K. (football)|Galatasaray]], and [[Fenerbahçe S.K. (football)|Fenerbahçe]]. After being bought by the Uzan family in 1990,{{cite book |last1=Cho |first1=Younghan |title=Football in Asia: History, Culture and Business |date=17 March 2016 |publisher=Routledge |isbn=978-1-317-59831-2 |url=https://books.google.com/books?id=AKXDCwAAQBAJ&dq=%22%C4%B0stanbulspor%22+bought+by+Uzan+Family&pg=PT90 |language=en}} it has been repossessed by the government and resold to third parties. Their greatest success is the [[Turkish Football Championship|Turkish championship title]] won in [[1932 Turkish Football Championship|1932]].{{cite web |title=Turkish Süper Lig - facts, stats and history |url=https://www.footballhistory.org/league/super-lig.html |website=www.footballhistory.org}}"}}
